Method
Offline-safe: no network calls at runtime. Contours measured via librosa.pyin, median-smoothed. Synth articulates amplitude from the tracker's per-frame voicing confidence, so voiced syllables swell and consonant frames duck — the pulse of real recitative. Next step: measure the same way against public recordings (PocketTorah, Virtual Cantor) to widen the bank.
